Ulysses S. Grant, Personal Memoirs of Ulysses S. Grant.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/ulysses-s-grant/personal-memoirs-of-ulysses-s-grant

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Ulysses S. Grant, the author, died 1885.

First publication of the text used: 1885 (SE colophon: 'Personal Memoirs of U. S. Grant was published in 1885 by Ulysses S. Grant.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1885, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 1980.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. Every person whose words are in the text died in 1885 or earlier, so the work is public domain in every country with a term of life + 100 years or less, whatever the country of first publication.
